name: fac-group-activity-bank
description: Proposes two or three group methods for each block of a session and writes each as a run list, producing the question, the steps, the timings you set, the materials, a virtual variant and a fallback, with the source named. Use for "run fac-group-activity-bank", "group activities for training", "workshop activities", "breakout activities", "something other than breakout rooms", "1-2-4-All", "world cafe", "how do I get everyone to take part", part of the Claude for Trainers and Facilitators Pack by 90n.
